text: This major aims to encourage students’ all-round development of morality, intelligence, and physique, cultivate their understanding of natural sciences, humanities, and social sciences, raise their knowledge of basic computer science theory, software engineering, and applications, and develop their capability in software development, preliminary experience in software implementation, as well as project planning and organization. Senior application-oriented personnel can engage in software engineering research, software design and development, software project management, and services. Main Courses: Object-Oriented Programming, Database Principles and Applications, Data Structures and Algorithms, Software Engineering, Computer Networks, Operating Systems, Computer Organization and Architecture, UML and Design Patterns, Software Quality Assurance and Testing, OpenGL Programming, Software Components and Middleware, Web Programming, Cloud Computing and Distributed Systems, Embedded Operating Systems, Embedded System Design, Computer Animation Design and Production, Digital Audio/Video Coding Technology, Parallel Computing, Massive Information Processing and Computing, Software Testing Technology, etc.
